# Historical September monthly reflection template

For October 2026 onward, use `biweekly-reflection-template.md` instead. Keep this file for the September monthly format.

## Name

Your name

## Date / Month

YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD

## What I Worked On

Describe the work you completed during this period.

## What I Learned

Describe useful technical, domain, or collaboration lessons.

## Results / Findings

Record concrete results, findings, measurements, or meaningful progress.

## Challenges / Blockers

Describe obstacles, unresolved issues, or support needed.

## Decisions / Contributions

Describe decisions you contributed to and how your work affected the project.

## Next Steps

List the work you plan to do next.
